name: engine_direct_flood
description: uds-mode distinct-id flood straight to the engine: 5000 synthesized agents each post the 50-line short syslog sample once, as one batch, to POST /events/enriched with X-Wazuh-Agent-Id (run with --socket <WAZUH_HOME>/queue/sockets/engine-ingest-http.sock). Every request is a new agent id, so it drives the engine's agent metadata cache through its insertion path without enrolling a fleet.
